subtitle_zh: 清晨，我们乘坐的“探索公主号”，缓缓驶入阿拉斯加的小镇史凯威。
subtitle_en: Early in the morning, our Discovery Princess slowly sailed into Skagway, Alaska.

subtitle_zh: 这是我第二次来到这里。第一次是在 2015 年，当时乘坐的是挪威邮轮。
subtitle_en: This was my second time here. The first time was in 2015, on Norwegian Cruise Line.

subtitle_zh: 转眼十一年过去，再次回到这座熟悉的小镇，心里多了一份故地重游的亲切感。
subtitle_en: Eleven years later, returning to this familiar town felt warm and familiar.

subtitle_zh: 这个时候，史凯威港口刚刚苏醒。
subtitle_en: At this moment, the port of Skagway was just waking up.

subtitle_zh: 随着一艘艘邮轮陆续靠港，整个港区也慢慢热闹起来。
subtitle_en: As cruise ships arrived one after another, the harbor slowly came alive.

subtitle_zh: 接驳小艇在海面上来回穿梭，把游客送上岸。
subtitle_en: Tender boats moved back and forth, carrying passengers to shore.

subtitle_zh: 观鲸船陆续启航，驶向附近海域。
subtitle_en: Whale-watching boats set out toward the nearby waters.

subtitle_zh: 直升机不断起降，载着游客飞往冰川和雪山。
subtitle_en: Helicopters took off and landed, carrying visitors toward glaciers and snowy mountains.

subtitle_zh: 这座平时只有几百名居民的小镇。
subtitle_en: This small town usually has only a few hundred residents.

subtitle_zh: 每到邮轮季，就会因为来自世界各地的游客而变得格外繁忙，也充满了活力。
subtitle_en: But during cruise season, visitors from around the world make it busy and full of life.

subtitle_zh: 而我们的史凯威之旅，也即将从这里开始。
subtitle_en: And our journey in Skagway was about to begin here.

subtitle_zh: 由于几年前铁路码头附近发生过山体滑坡，部分码头到现在仍然受到安全限制。
subtitle_en: A past landslide near the railroad dock still keeps some areas restricted for safety.

subtitle_zh: 因此，这一次我们没有直接从邮轮走上码头。
subtitle_en: So this time, we did not walk directly from the ship to the dock.

subtitle_zh: 而是乘坐接驳小艇，前往岸边。
subtitle_en: Instead, we took a tender boat to shore.
